inclusion.I1: Empirical English-language structural MRI studies comparing patients with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder or first-episode psychosis against a healthy control group.
inclusion.I2: The analysis must be VOXEL-WISE (VBM, voxel-based morphometry, SPM voxelwise). ROI-only or atlas/parcellation-only designs such as FreeSurfer region tables do NOT qualify, because they report per-region values rather than the stereotactic coordinates a coordinate-based meta-analysis requires.

exclusion.E1: Reviews, meta-analyses, case reports, and single-patient studies.
exclusion.E2: Purely functional studies (fMRI, PET, MEG, EEG) with no structural morphometric outcome.
exclusion.E3: ROI-based or atlas-based-only morphometry with no voxel-wise whole-brain analysis.
exclusion.E4: Studies only of clinical high-risk or unaffected relatives with no patient-versus-control comparison.

inclusion.I3: Reports coordinates in a standard stereotactic space (MNI or Talairach) for at least one patient-versus-control grey-matter contrast.

exclusion.E6: No stereotactic coordinates reported anywhere for a structural patient-versus-control contrast.
exclusion.E7: Coordinates reported only for functional or diffusion measures, not grey-matter structure.

inclusion.GLOBAL_I1: Judge each analysis from its own name, description and table caption, plus the study text for sample characteristics. An empty or generic analysis name is never itself a reason to exclude.
inclusion.GLOBAL_I2: Coordinates must be in MNI or Talairach space.

exclusion.GLOBAL_E1: Exclude analyses that are not a patient-versus-control grey-matter comparison.

inclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_I1: The contrast is schizophrenia-spectrum patients versus healthy controls.
inclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_I2: The direction is controls GREATER than patients, i.e. reduced grey matter, atrophy or decreased volume/density in patients.

exclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_E1: Patients GREATER than controls (increased grey matter).
exclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_E2: Contrasts between two patient groups, or against clinical high-risk or relative groups rather than healthy controls.
exclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_E3: Correlations with symptom severity, duration or dose rather than a group contrast.

inclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_ANTIPSYCHOTIC_NAIVE_I1: The patient sample is described as antipsychotic-naive, drug-naive, medication-free or unmedicated at scanning.
inclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_ANTIPSYCHOTIC_NAIVE_I2: The contrast is patients versus healthy controls, direction controls GREATER than patients.

exclusion.SCZ_ATROPHY_ANTIPSYCHOTIC_NAIVE_E1: Medicated or mixed-medication samples, or samples whose medication status is not stated.
